physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Captured candidate 1 used utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=0 and both RTL actions. Its cell_area_um2=160081 versus baseline 161954 (area_ratio=0.988435), but setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439 versus baseline +0.19292; hold_slack_ns=+0.0945523 and all slew/cap/fanout violation counts were zero. The evaluator reported physical_qualified=false, rank_eligible=false and failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing]. Workload energies were absent, so no energy improvement or qualified Q can be inferred from the area reduction. Choose the unseen tuple with the same four physical parameters, operand_isolation=false and reduce_width=true. Retain the correctness-qualified exact signed 18-bit reduction, sign extended to 32 bits with unchanged cycle contract, to target redundant arithmetic area and switching. Disable isolation to remove its additional multiply-input gates and potential input delay. The combined-action measurement cannot establish which action caused the timing failure, and removing isolation may increase idle switching; recovering timing and lowering Q remain hypotheses requiring evaluation. Keep abc_area=0 to avoid the timing risk of area-oriented mapping; keep utilization=40 and density=0.55 to isolate this action change from placement effects. Keep repair_margin=0 because the captured failure has no electrical violations. Die area reduction alone earns no objective improvement. One of three accepted candidate evaluations has been used; submit only this next candidate within the shared 1200-second agent budget, with EDA wait accounted separately. Retain candidate 1 and its physical_wall_seconds=3420.889992701006, postprocess_wall_seconds=4.1100429370999336e-7, total_wall_seconds=3420.8899931120104 and reported elapsed_search_seconds=3585.433121506998; do not treat that EDA-inclusive elapsed field as agent-only time. The qualified baseline remains the incumbent with Q=1. Evaluate Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6) only when physical_qualified, measurement_qualified and rank_eligible pass. Report actual cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, all energy_j and estimated_power_w values, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, qualification flags, failure_classes and execution costs; assess the frozen 1.0 and 0.98 thresholds and retain the best qualified result and all failures. Energy scope remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF, without silicon or delay/glitch-power claims. This proposal has no new EDA or workload measurement.
